name: print-social-cream-lime-fashion-editorial-template-set
title: Cream and Lime Fashion Template Set
whatItIs: Six portrait templates on black: a grainy quote card, an in-store event card, a hiring post on grid paper, a gifting collage, a blurred 'Coming soon' oval frame and a sale post.
whatItMeans: Cream, black and acid-lime feel fashionable and editorial, while blur, grain and script accents feel current.
techniques: Pair heavy sans with italic script for contrast
Acid-lime as a single accent across all templates
Motion blur on portraits for movement
Oval photo masks and grid backgrounds as variety
Small metadata captions and rules like a magazine

vocabulary.definition: An italic script word set within a sans headline.
A photo with deliberate blur to suggest movement.
Layouts sharing type and color but differing in structure.
